title: I-35E Dallas Halperin Park

pageHeader.title: Halperin Park at the Dallas Zoo

text:
The reconstruction of I-35E, called the Southern Gateway project, included a deck at Ewing Avenue for a future park.

In September 2022 the freeway and deck were complete. Construction of the park began in 2024.

In April 2025 the park was named Halperin Park, following a $23 million contribution from the Halperin Foundation, which is the philanthropic organization of Jim Halperin, co-founder of Dallas-based Heritage Auctions. Phase 1 of Halperin Park was expected to cost $122 million. Total estimated cost including phase 2 is $300 million, according to a Dec. 31, 2025, Dallas Morning News report.
